issue_body: I'm using the heading formatter to clean up titles and the output isn't quite right - the capitalization seems wrong in places for some of my titles. Can you figure out what's going on and fix it so headings come out properly?
prompt: This build adds a custom string helper, Math.heading(input: string): string, that formats arbitrary text into a display heading. I'm using it to clean up titles and the output isn't quite right - the capitalization seems wrong in places for some of my titles. Short, simple titles look fine, but some of my titles come back looking off. Can you figure out what's going on and fix it so headings come out properly for a range of titles?
expected_behavior: Headings are formatted consistently and correctly for a range of titles.
skills_tested: inferring an undocumented contract from source code
finding unmentioned defects beyond the one reported symptom
off-by-one and boundary reasoning across multiple helper methods
distinguishing the hinted symptom from independent latent bugs
